name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Anyone can now download a friend's title to their phone or computer with their app's normal Download button (web, Jellyfin for Android, Findroid, Swiftfin). The file comes straight from the friend's server with its real name; if that isn't possible your server passes it through, and interrupted downloads resume. The friend's download permission and per-viewer rules apply. New: friends' favorites. Your Favorites tab shows a "Favorites on (friend)" row per friend with the titles their users favorited (titles only, never who, only titles you can already open). Both can be turned off in Advanced. Fixes the old web "Download to device" option, which only worked on the server itself. Friends need 0.0.188 for direct downloads and favorites; with older friends downloads go through your server.
